lanes.hypothesis: Does within-precision greedy AR agreement improve under full FP32 for the main8B verifier on the same sixteen questions used for the0.6B diagnostic?
lanes.scope: Eight exposed GSM8K questions per shard, two shards per precision. Same frozen8B dense mapper. FP32 changes all model/mapper execution and kernel dispatch, with TF32 disabled. Numerical diagnostic, not proof of exactness for all prompts.
